bio: The son of Ammihud. He represented Simeon in the division of the land (Num. 34:20).

name: Shemuel
bio: A prince of the tribe of Issachar (1 Chr. 7:2).

name: Shephatiah
bio: A Benjamite who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:5).

name: Shephatiah
bio: A Simeonite prince in David’s time (1 Chr. 27:16).

name: Shephatiah
bio: One of Jehoshaphat’s sons (2 Chr. 21:2).

name: Shephatiah
bio: One of the princes who urged the putting of Jeremiah to death (Jer. 38:1-4).

name: Sheresh
bio: Root, a descendant of Manasseh (1 Chr. 7:16).

name: Sherezer
bio: One of the messengers whom the children of the Captivity sent to Jerusalem “to pray for them before the Lord” (Zech. 7:2).

name: Shethar
bio: A star, a prince at the court of Ahasuerus (Esther 1:14).

name: Sheva
bio: The son of Caleb (1 Chr. 2:49).

name: Shimea
bio: A Levite of the family of Merari (1 Chr. 6:30).

name: Shimea
bio: Another Levite of the family of Gershon (1 Chr. 6:39).

name: Shimeah
bio: A Benjamite, a descendant of Gibeon (1 Chr. 8:32); called also Shimeam (9:38).

name: Shimei
bio: A Levite of the family of Gershon (1 Chr. 6:42).

name: Shimei
bio: A son of Pedaiah, the brother of Zerubbabel (1 Chr. 3:19).

name: Shimei
bio: A Reubenite (1 Chr. 5:4).

name: Shimei
bio: A Ramathite who was “over the vineyards” of David (1 Chr. 27:27).

name: Shimei
bio: One of the sons of Heman, who assisted in the purification of the temple (2 Chr. 29:14).

name: Shimeon
bio: Hearkening. Ezra 10:31.

name: Shimhi
bio: Famous, a Benjamite (1 Chr. 8:21).

name: Shimri
bio: A Simeonite (1 Chr. 4:37).

name: Shimri
bio: The father of one of the “valiant men” of David’s armies (1 Chr. 11:45).

name: Shimri
bio: Assisted at the purification of the temple in the time of Hezekiah (2 Chr. 29:13).

name: Shinab
bio: Cooling, the king of Adamah, in the valley of Siddim, who with his confederates was conquered by Chedorlaomer (Gen. 14:2).

name: Shiphrah
bio: Beauty, one of the Egyptian midwives (Ex. 1:15).

name: Shiphtan
bio: Judicial, an Ephraimite prince at the time of the division of Canaan (Num. 34:24).

name: Shobab
bio: One of the sons of Caleb (1 Chr. 2:18), the son of Hezron.

name: Shobi
bio: Captor, son of Nahash of Rabbah, the Ammonite. He showed kindness to David when he fled from Jerusalem to Mahanaim (2 Sam. 17:27).

name: Shua
bio: A daughter of Heber the Asherite (1 Chr. 7:32).

name: Simeon
bio: One of the ancestors of Joseph (Luke 3:30).

name: Simeon
bio: Surnamed Niger, i.e., “black,” perhaps from his dark complexion, a teacher of some distinction in the church of Antioch (Acts 13:1-3). It has been supposed that this was the Simon of Cyrene who bore Christ’s cross.

name: Simri
bio: Watchman, a Levite of the family of Merari (1 Chr. 26:10).

name: So
bio: (Nubian, Sabako), an Ethiopian king who brought Egypt under his sway. He was bribed by Hoshea to help him against the Assyrian monarch Shalmaneser (2 Kings 17:4). This was a return to the policy that had been successful in the reign of Jeroboam I.

name: Stachys
bio: Spike; an ear of corn, a convert at Rome whom Paul salutes (Rom. 16:9).

name: Susanna
bio: Lily, with other pious women, ministered to Jesus (Luke 8:3).

name: Susi
bio: The father of Gaddi, who was one of the twelve spies (Num. 13:11).

name: Syntyche
bio: Fortunate; affable, a female member of the church at Philippi, whom Paul beseeches to be of one mind with Euodias (Phil. 4:2, 3).

name: Tabeal
bio: Goodness of God, the father of one whom the kings of Syria and Samaria in vain attempted to place on the throne of Ahaz (Isa. 7:6).

name: Tabeel
bio: A Persian governor of Samaria, who joined others in the attempt to prevent the rebuilding of Jerusalem (Ezra 4:7).

name: Tabrimon
bio: Good is Rimmon, the father of Benhadad, king of Syria (1 Kings 15:18).

name: Tamar
bio: A daughter of Absalom (2 Sam. 14:27).

name: Temeni
bio: One of the sons of Ashur, the father of Tekoa (1 Chr. 4:6).

name: Thahash
bio: A badger, a son of Nahor, Abraham’s brother (Gen. 22:24).

name: Theudas
bio: Thanksgiving, referred to by Gamaliel in his speech before the council at Jerusalem (Acts 5:36). He headed an insurrection against the Roman authority. Beyond this nothing is known of him.

name: Tiberius
bio: I.e., as known in Roman history, Tiberius Claudius Nero, only mentioned in Luke 3:1. He was the stepson of Augustus, whom he succeeded on the throne, A.D. 14. He was noted for his vicious and infamous life.

name: Timaeus
bio: Defiled, the father of blind Bartimaeus (Mark 10:46).

name: Timon
bio: Honouring, one of the seven deacons at Jerusalem (Acts 6:5). Nothing further is known of him.

name: Tobadonijah
bio: Good is Jehovah, my Lord, a Levite sent out by Jehoshaphat to instruct the people of Judah in the law (2 Chr. 17:8).

name: Tobijah
bio: Id., a Levite sent out through Judah by Jehoshaphat to teach the people (2 Chr. 17:8).

name: Tola
bio: A judge of the tribe of Issachar who “judged” Israel twenty-three years (Judg. 10:1, 2), when he died, and was buried in Shamir. He was succeeded by Jair.

name: Tubal-cain
bio: The son of Lamech and Zillah, “an instructor of every artificer in brass and iron” (Gen. 4:22; R.V., “the forger of every cutting instrument of brass and iron”).

name: Tyrannus
bio: Prince, a Greek rhetorician, in whose “school” at Ephesus Paul disputed daily for the space of two years with those who came to him (Acts 19:9). Some have supposed that he was a Jew, and that his “school” was a private synagogue.

name: Ucal
bio: The name of a person to whom Agur’s words are addressed (Prov. 30:1).

name: Unni
bio: A Levite who returned with Zerubbabel from the Captivity (Neh. 12:9).

name: Uriel
bio: The father of Michaiah, one of Rehoboam’s wives, and mother of Abijah (2 Chr. 13:2).

name: Urijah
bio: One of the priests who stood at the right hand of Ezra’s pulpit when he read and expounded the law (Neh. 8:4).

name: Uzzi
bio: A son of Bela, and grandson of Benjamin (1 Chr. 7:7).

name: Uzzi
bio: A Benjamite, a chief in the tribe (1 Chr. 9:8).

name: Uzzi
bio: A son of Bani. He had the oversight of the Levites after the return from captivity (Neh. 11:22).

name: Uzzi
bio: The head of the house of Jedaiah, one of “the chief of the priests” (Neh. 12:19).

name: Uzzi
bio: A priest who assisted in the dedication of the walls of Jerusalem (Neh. 12:42).

name: Uzziah
bio: The father of Jehonathan, one of David’s overseers (1 Chr. 27:25).

name: Uzziel
bio: A son of Bela, and grandson of Benjamin (1 Chr. 7:7).

name: Uzziel
bio: A son of Jeduthan (2 Chr. 29:14).

name: Uzziel
bio: The son of Harhaiah (Neh. 3:8).

name: Vajezatha
bio: Purity; worthy of honour, one of Haman’s sons, whom the Jews slew in the palace of Shushan (Esther 9:9).

name: Zabad
bio: One of David’s valiant men (1 Chr. 11:41), the descendant of Ahlai, of the “children of Sheshan” (2:31).

name: Zabad
bio: Ezra 10:27.

name: Zabad
bio: Ezra 10:33.

name: Zabad
bio: Ezra 10:43.

name: Zabbai
bio: Ezra 10:28.

name: Zabbai
bio: The father of Baruch, who “earnestly repaired” part of the wall of Jerusalem (Neh. 3:20; marg., “Zaccai”).

name: Zabbud
bio: Gift, Ezra 8:14.

name: Zabdi
bio: A Benjamite (1 Chr. 8:19).

name: Zabdi
bio: Called “the Shiphmite,” one of David’s officers, who had charge of his vineyards (1 Chr. 27:27).

name: Zabdiel
bio: The father of Jashobeam, who was one of David’s officers (1 Chr. 27:2).

name: Zabdiel
bio: An overseer of the priests after the Captivity (Neh. 11:14).

name: Zabud
bio: Gift, the son of Nathan, who was “king’s friend” in the court of Solomon (1 Kings 4:5).

name: Zaccur
bio: Father of Shammua, who was one of the spies sent out by Moses (Num. 13:4).

name: Zaccur
bio: A Merarite Levite (1 Chr. 24:27).

name: Zaccur
bio: Son of Imri (Neh. 3:2).

name: Zaccur
bio: A Levite (Neh. 10:12).

name: Zaccur
bio: The son of Mattaniah (Neh. 13:13).

name: Zadok
bio: The sons of Baana, one of those who assisted in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem (Neh. 3:4).

name: Zadok
bio: “The scribe” set over the treasuries of the temple by Nehemiah along with a priest and a Levite (Neh. 13:13).

name: Zatthu
bio: A sprout, Neh. 10:14.

name: Zaza
bio: Plenty, a descendant of Judah (1 Chr. 2:33).

name: Zebadiah
bio: A son of Beriah (1 Chr. 8:15).

name: Zebadiah
bio: A Korhite porter of the Lord’s house (1 Chr. 26:2). Three or four others of this name are also mentioned.

name: Zebadiah
bio: A son of Asahel, Joab’s brother (1 Chr. 27:7).

name: Zebadiah
bio: A Levite who took part as one of the teachers in the system of national education instituted by Jehoshaphat (2 Chr. 17:7, 8).

name: Zebadiah
bio: The son of Ishmael, “the ruler of the house of Judah in all the king’s matters” (2 Chr. 19:8-11).

name: Zebudah
bio: Given, the wife of Josiah and mother of Jehoiakim (2 Kings 23:36).

name: Zechariah
bio: One of the chiefs of the tribe of Reuben (1 Chr. 5:7).

name: Zechariah
bio: A Kohathite Levite (1 Chr. 24:25).

name: Zechariah
bio: A Merarite Levite (1 Chr. 27:21).

name: Zechariah
bio: One who assisted in teaching the law to the people in the time of Jehoshaphat (2 Chr. 17:7).

name: Zechariah
bio: A Levite of the sons of Asaph (2 Chr. 20:14).

name: Zechariah
bio: One of Jehoshaphat’s sons (2 Chr. 21:2).

name: Zechariah
bio: A prophet, who had “understanding in the seeing of God,” in the time of Uzziah, who was much indebted to him for his wise counsel (2 Chr. 26:5). Besides these, there is a large number of persons mentioned in Scripture bearing this name of whom nothing is known.

name: Zechariah
bio: One of the “rulers of the house of God” (2 Chr. 35:8).

name: Zedekiah
bio: The son of Hananiah, a prince of Judah in the days of Jehoiakim (Jer. 36:12).

name: Zemira
bio: Vine-dresser, a Benjamite; one of the sons of Becher (1 Chr. 7:8).

name: Zenas
bio: A disciple called “the lawyer,” whom Paul wished Titus to bring with him (Titus 3:13). Nothing more is known of him.

name: Zerah
bio: An “Ethiopian,” probably Osorkon II., the successor of Shishak on the throne of Egypt. With an enormous army, the largest we read of in Scripture, he invaded the kingdom of Judah in the days of Asa (2 Chr. 14:9-15). He reached Zephathah, and there encountered the army of Asa.

name: Zeruah
bio: Stricken, mother of Jeroboam, the first king of the ten tribes (1 Kings 11:26).

name: Zethan
bio: A Benjamite (1 Chr. 7:10).

name: Zia
bio: Fear, a Gadite (1 Chr. 5:13).

name: Zibia
bio: Gazelle, a Benjamite (1 Chr. 8:9).

name: Zichri
bio: A Benjamite chief (1 Chr. 8:19).

name: Zichri
bio: Another of the same tribe (1 Chr. 8:23).

name: Zidkijah
bio: The Lord is righteous, one who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah (Neh. 10:1).

name: Ziha
bio: A ruler among the Nethinim (Neh. 11:21).

name: Zilthai
bio: A Benjamite (1 Chr. 8:20).

name: Zilthai
bio: One of the captains of the tribe of Manasseh who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr. 12:20).

name: Zimmah
bio: The father of Joah (2 Chr. 29:12).

name: Ziphah
bio: A descendant of Judah (1 Chr. 4:16).

name: Zithri
bio: The Lord protects, a Levite, son of Uzziel (Ex. 6:22).

name: Ziza
bio: A Simeonite prince (1 Chr. 4:37-43).

name: Ziza
bio: A son of Rehoboam (2 Chr. 11:20).

name: Zoheth
bio: Snatching (?), one of the sons of Ishi (1 Chr. 4:20).

name: Zuriel
bio: Rock of God, chief of the family of the Merarites (Num. 3:35) at the time of the Exodus.
